test_dictionary_finalize: test the fairseq Dictionary finalize method to reorder tokens by frequency and save to disk
test_dictionary_encode_line: test the fairseq Dictionary encode_line method to convert text tokens into integer ID tensors
test_dictionary_add_from_file: test the fairseq Dictionary add_from_file method to load entries with fairseq:overwrite support
test_dictionary_add_file_to_dictionary: test the fairseq Dictionary add_file_to_dictionary method to build a dictionary from a text file with token counts
test_dictionary_index: test the fairseq Dictionary index method to look up the integer index of a token string
